newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends firm vs dlr, BCE Ecu futures rise.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends firm vs dlr, BCE Ecu futures rise.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar and halved the gap that separated it from the central bank bid, dealers said on Monday.
"After an initial spate of foreign currency buying, the selling side dominated the rest of the day," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
The forint closed at 153.87/92 against the dollar compared with an opening of 154.02.07 and a morning low of 154.08, dealers said.
By Monday's close, the forint was some 15 pips weaker than the central bank bid.
